outcome: maternal origin of four X chromosomes due to non-disjunction in meiosis I and II
cohort: A 1-year-old female baby diagnosed with pentasomy X (49,XXXXX).
finding: A 1-year-old female with pentasomy X presented with thenar atrophy (a novel finding), postnatal growth deficiency, developmental delay, and other characteristic malformations, with molecular analysis indicating maternal origin of four X chromosomes due to successive non-disjunction.
